raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "cmd2" %}
{% set version = "4.1.2" %}
{% set bundle = "tar.gz" %}
{% set hash = "07e62b40235ae4af1c5730fb6b3a4708456b57b9ff79acf02808ac584263290a" %}
{% set python_min = "3.11" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.{{ bundle }}
  sha256: {{ hash }}

build:
  number: 0
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  noarch: python

requirements:

  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools_scm
    - setuptools
    - python-build

  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - prompt-toolkit >=3.0.52
    - pyperclip >=1.8.2
    - rich >=15.0.0
    - rich-argparse >=1.7.2

test:
  imports:
    - cmd2
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://github.com/python-cmd2/cmd2
  license_file: LICENSE
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  summary: Extra features for standard library's cmd module
  dev_url: https://github.com/python-cmd2/cmd2
  doc_url: https://cmd2.readthedocs.io/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - anguslees
    - tschoonj
